findings.label: Missing recorded verification evidence
findings.detail: The task refers to harness results in the coder's final message / commit notes, but the work is uncommitted (no commit notes) and the only artifact is .agents/tasks/plan.md with every step still unchecked. No recorded harness output is in the repo. The batch-selection and progress logic were reviewed directly instead and are correct; future passes should capture the harness run output alongside the change.

findings.label: Invalid numbers consume a daily slot every run
findings.detail: pilihBatch leaves numbers normalizing to < 10 digits in the batch; kirim.js skips them without marking them sent, so they reappear and occupy one of the PER_HARI slots on every future run. Harmless for valid hand-entered Indonesian numbers; no change required for the stated use case.
